from.place: Coefficient-unit cancellation at the tensor input.

title: The coefficient unit and tensor comparison
statement: For categories A and B, an equivalence R:A≌B, a curried tensor functor T:A→A→A, k,a,c:A and an isomorphism e:a≅c, unitTensorRealization is the isomorphism R⁻¹(R(T(k,a)))≅T(k,c) obtained by the inverse unit of R followed by T(k,e).

proof.text: Take the inverse equivalence unit at T(k,a), then compose it with the result of applying T(k,-) to e. Both endpoints are explicitly stated and both factors are supplied isomorphisms. This constructs the comparison without choosing an object or postponing a proof.

lean.statement:
def unitTensorRealization
    {A B : Type*} [Category A] [Category B] (R : A ≌ B)
    (T : A ⥤ A ⥤ A) (k : A) {a c : A} (e : a ≅ c) :
    R.inverse.obj (R.functor.obj ((T.obj k).obj a)) ≅
      (T.obj k).obj c
